task.description: Design test cases for EE-09 (Variable scoping and merge). Write a test specification to tests/specs/EE-09.md covering: (1) TC-EE-09-01: New key insert — task completes with output_variables containing key not in instance map → key inserted, no VARIABLE_OVERWRITTEN event; (2) TC-EE-09-02: Existing key overwrite (no schema) — key present in instance map, new value, no schema registered → key overwritten, VARIABLE_OVERWRITTEN event appended with old/new values; (3) TC-EE-09-03: Existing key overwrite with schema-compatible value → same as TC-EE-09-02 but schema exists and new value passes validation; (4) TC-EE-09-04: Schema violation — existing key, schema rejects new value → merge NOT applied, instance transitions to ERROR, EXECUTION_ERROR event appended (type=SCHEMA_VIOLATION), task completion returns HTTP 422; (5) TC-EE-09-05: Empty output_variables — task completes with {} → no events emitted, instance variable map unchanged; (6) TC-EE-09-06: Multiple keys in one completion — mix of new keys and existing keys (some overwritten, no violations) → all keys correctly handled, one VARIABLE_OVERWRITTEN event per overwritten key; (7) TC-EE-09-07: Merged variables immediately available to CEL — after merge, an EXCLUSIVE_GATEWAY uses the newly merged variable in a condition and routes correctly (EE-05 integration); (8) TC-EE-09-08: Task completion attempt on instance in ERROR status → HTTP 409. Also add unit test cases for the mergeVariables function and the json_schema validator in tests/unit/.
acceptance_criteria: tests/specs/EE-09.md created with TC-EE-09-01 through TC-EE-09-08
Each test case has: preconditions, steps, expected outcome, and which acceptance criterion it covers
Unit test cases specified for mergeVariables three-path logic
Test cases follow conventions in test_developer_guide.md

result.summary: Test spec and test code for EE-09 (Variable scoping and merge). Created tests/unit/test_ee09_merge_variables.zig covering json_schema validator constraints (type, enum, minimum, maximum, maxLength) and mergeVariables empty-output fast path (no DB call). Created tests/integration/ee09_merge_variables_test.zig with TC-EE-09-01, TC-EE-09-02, TC-EE-09-04, TC-EE-09-05. Registered engine_ee09_tests step in build.zig.
